name: Astrid Winfir
source: Astrid is a Holy Knight serving in Queen Illitris's army. She's known as The Banshee of Morvon Grove and is one of the best swordfighters in the kingdom of Threcia. She's confident, stoic, and all business. But longs to find love even though her work prevents it.
